resources.string: Connectivity trial for Wear OS watches. View pulse data shared by your watch and review available blood-pressure readings before saving.
Pulse alone cannot reliably calculate blood pressure. We do not generate pressure numbers from sensors without an existing measurement.
Only Health Connect records identified as coming from a watch are shown. Availability depends on your watch, apps and permissions.
Could not read Health Connect. Check connection and permissions.
Permissions were not granted. Manual entry remains available.
Health Connect is unavailable or needs installation or an update.
No blood-pressure readings identified as coming from a watch. You can still enter readings manually.
%1$d / %2$d mmHg will be added to local history. Check that it matches your measurement. It does not replace a validated cuff.
Manual entry remains available. This beta does not sync automatically or share data with our servers.

With your permission, this beta reads heart rate and blood pressure from Health Connect only when you ask it to find data. It shows records identified as coming from a watch. A pressure reading is saved on this device only after you confirm it; you can later delete or export it. No accounts, automatic sync or transfer to our servers. Manual entry works without granting access.
